title: Refined collection cards verified
summary: Verified continuous borders, separate captions and improved photo framing at mobile and desktop widths.

changes.detail: Replace obscured inset borders with real continuous borders. Place captions in normal flow below artwork, avoiding abrupt overlap and uneven spacing.
Show complete portrait images with logos and reserve badge clearance. Balance image regions across all cards, soften corner radii and badges, and refine green arrow controls.

validation.name: Responsive browser component checks
validation.detail: Actual component rendered with fixture data in Chrome at 375, 482 and 1280px. All images load, white-card text is dark green, overlays are absent, borders are 1px and caption bounds start below image bounds. Screenshots visually inspected at all widths; logos remain visible.

validation.name: Lint and typecheck
validation.detail: Focused CategoryTiles ESLint and learning app npm run typecheck passed.

validation.name: Live integration
validation.detail: Checks use isolated component fixtures, not live API data. No deployment performed.
